Request For Proposal- Paulding County JFS
Click link to view: https://www.pauldingcountyoh.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/07/LEGAL-NOTICE-RFP-Paulding-County-JFS.docx
Public Notice is given that Paulding County is in the process of executing a new Programmatic Agreement with Ohio’s State Historic Preservation Office (SHPO) to facilitate Section 106 compliance for programs that use funding originating from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (HUD). A 15-day comment period is from November 22, 2025, to December 7, 2025 and a draft Programmatic Agreement is available by November 22, 2025, at 1300 E Second Street or https://www.mvpo.org/contact/c1d94g
For your convenience, if you need to drop off payments or documents you may use the NEW MAROON Drop Box located on the sidewalk of the Main Entrance to the Courthouse and also a drop box located on the West Side doors of the Courthouse. Please place payments/documents in a sealed envelope with your name and what office your payment/documents is going to.
To make a payment on your property tax, please click on the link. https://www.pauldingcountytreasurer.com/real-estate-tax/

County Government and Officials
Our Board of County Commissioners, allows the Paulding County Government provide services to Paulding County towns and residents. This site links you to the county’s programs, services, and departments.
Our Elected Officials work together for the county of Paulding Co. This includes a county auditor, clerk of courts, commissioners, common pleas, engineer, municipal judge, probate/juvenile, prosecutor, recorder, sheriff, and treasurer.
LEARN MORE >
County Services
We offer a wide variety of services from animal shelters and economic development to emergency management and veteran services. Please review our services area at the top of the page for more information.
